items.name: Claude Fable
items.why: Anthropic 最強大的公開 AI 模型，在 SWE-bench Pro 編碼基準測試中表現卓越，並已整合至 GitHub Copilot，為遊戲編程提供強大基礎。
items.why_en: Anthropic's most powerful public AI model, excelling in SWE-bench Pro coding benchmarks and integrated into GitHub Copilot, providing a strong foundation for game programming.

items.name: Cursor Composer
items.why: Cursor IDE 內建的專有編碼模型，專為跨文件、工具和終端命令的代理式軟體工程任務設計，提升複雜開發工作的處理能力。
items.why_en: Cursor's proprietary coding model within the Cursor IDE, designed for agentic software engineering tasks spanning multiple files, tools, and terminal commands, enhancing complex development workflows.

items.name: GitHub Copilot
items.why: 透過整合 Claude Fable 5，顯著提升了其在遊戲開發中的編碼輔助能力，成為廣泛使用的強大 AI 編程工具。
items.why_en: Significantly enhances its coding assistance capabilities for game development through the integration of Claude Fable 5, making it a powerful and widely used AI programming tool.

items.why_en: As a flagship multimodal model, Gemini 3.5 Pro features a 2-million-token context window and Deep Think reasoning mode, significantly enhancing complex data reasoning capabilities.

items.name: Claude Opus
items.why: Claude Opus 4.8 在複雜分析任務、多步驟邏輯和困難學科問題上表現卓越，是目前最強大的通用推理模型之一。
items.why_en: Claude Opus 4.8 excels in complex analytical tasks, multi-step logic, and difficult subject-matter questions, making it one of the most powerful general reasoning models available.

items.name: Genie
items.why: Databricks Genie 是一個企業級平台，用於構建和管理 AI 代理，通過其本體論（Ontology）上下文層，顯著提升了企業級數據推理和自動化工作流的能力。
items.why_en: Databricks Genie is an enterprise-grade platform for building and managing AI agents, significantly enhancing enterprise-level data reasoning and automated workflows through its Ontology context layer.

items.name: GLM
items.why: GLM-5.2 是一個領先的開源模型，具備 100 萬 token 的上下文窗口，在代理編碼和代碼庫規模推理方面表現強勁，為開發者提供了高效的數據推理工具。
items.why_en: GLM-5.2 is a leading open-source model with a 1-million-token context window, demonstrating strong performance in agentic coding and repository-scale reasoning, providing efficient data reasoning tools for developers.

items.name: Kimi K2.7 Code
items.why: Kimi K2.7 Code 是一個開源的萬億參數 MoE 編碼模型，專為長周期任務設計，具有超長上下文和強大的推理能力，尤其適用於複雜的數據相關編碼和推理場景。
items.why_en: Kimi K2.7 Code is an open-source trillion-parameter MoE coding model designed for long-horizon tasks, featuring ultra-long context and strong reasoning capabilities, especially suitable for complex data-related coding and reasoning scenarios.

overall.why_en: Clear commercial licensing; embed SFX in tracks, mid-track genre switch

overall.name: Suno v5.5
overall.why: 消費級音樂龍頭,語音擷取、自訂模型
overall.why_en: Consumer music leader; voice capture, custom models

overall.name: Lyria 3 Pro
overall.why: 最長 3 分鐘結構化曲目,SynthID 浮水印
overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 7 月)無正式發佈項目，故列出近 30-60 天內發佈的最佳 5 個項目。
monthly.note_en: No official releases in July 2026, so the list comprises the top 5 releases from the past 30-60 days.

items.name: Stable Audio 3.0
items.why: 一個全新的 AI 音樂模型家族，能生成長達 6 分 20 秒的音樂和音效，並提供開源模型和音訊對音訊編輯功能。
items.why_en: A new family of AI music models capable of generating music and sound effects up to 6 minutes and 20 seconds, offering open-weight models and audio-to-audio editing capabilities.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music
items.why: 透過 API 引入基於區塊的作曲計畫，提供對音樂結構、節奏和編曲更精細的控制。
items.why_en: Introduces chunk-based composition plans via API, offering finer control over music structure, pacing, and arrangement.

items.name: Suno Stem Separation Tool
items.why: 為 Premier 訂閱者提供「進階分離」功能，可精確提取近百種樂器音軌，大幅提升音樂編輯靈活性。
items.why_en: Offers 'Advanced Split' for Premier subscribers, allowing precise extraction of nearly 100 instrument tracks, significantly enhancing music editing flexibility.

items.name: ElevenLabs Speech Engine
items.why: 為聊天代理和大型語言模型提供即時語音功能，處理語音轉文字、輪流發言和文字轉語音，實現更自然的語音互動。
items.why_en: Provides real-time voice capabilities for chat agents and LLMs, handling speech-to-text, turn-taking, and text-to-speech for more natural voice interactions.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music
items.why: 為音樂生成 API 增加了 mp3_48000_240 和 mp3_48000_320 等更高品質的輸出格式，提升音訊保真度。
items.why_en: Added higher-quality output formats like mp3_48000_240 and mp3_48000_320 to the music generation API, enhancing audio fidelity.

items.name: Microsoft Copilot Cowork (GA)
items.why: Copilot Cowork正式發佈，提供多工具、長任務的代理能力，並整合M365生態系統，實現企業級AI自動化。
items.why_en: Copilot Cowork officially launched, offering multi-tool, long-running agentic capabilities integrated within the M365 ecosystem for enterprise-grade AI automation.

items.name: n8n AI Agent Node with Multi-Model Tool Calling
items.why: n8n的AI Agent節點重構，支援Claude、GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro等多模型工具呼叫，大幅提升複雜AI工作流的自動化能力。
items.why_en: n8n's rebuilt AI Agent node supports multi-model tool calling across Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and more, significantly enhancing complex AI workflow automation.

items.name: Anthropic Claude Managed Agents (Public Beta)
items.why: Claude Managed Agents推出公開測試版，支援排程運行、安全存取CLI工具和認證服務，實現自動化、重複性的AI任務。
items.why_en: Claude Managed Agents launched public beta, supporting scheduled runs, secure access to CLI tools and authenticated services, enabling automated, recurring AI tasks.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music v2 API
items.why: ElevenLabs Music v2 API發佈，引入基於區塊的作曲計畫，提供對音樂結構、節奏和編曲更精細的控制，強化多模態內容創作。
items.why_en: ElevenLabs Music v2 API launched, introducing chunk-based composition plans for finer control over music structure, pacing, and arrangement, enhancing multimodal content creation.

items.name: Raycast AI v2 Personalization & Dictation
items.why: Raycast AI v2新增個人化設定（Profile, Memory）和系統級聽寫功能，讓AI助理更具上下文感知能力並提升輸入效率。
items.why_en: Raycast AI v2 adds personalization (Profile, Memory) and system-wide dictation, making the AI assistant more context-aware and improving input efficiency.

items.name: GitHub Copilot Enterprise with Custom Knowledge Bases
items.why: GitHub Copilot Enterprise深度整合組織內部知識庫，提供基於專有文檔和代碼模式的AI建議，加速開發者入職與效率。
items.why_en: GitHub Copilot Enterprise deeply integrates with internal knowledge bases, offering AI suggestions grounded in proprietary documentation and code patterns, accelerating developer onboarding and efficiency.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot GitHub Server Knowledge Connector
items.why: 新的連接器將GitHub Enterprise Server知識庫整合到Microsoft 365 Copilot中，讓用戶能在M365應用中直接查詢GitHub文檔。
items.why_en: New connector integrates GitHub Enterprise Server knowledge bases into Microsoft 365 Copilot, allowing users to query GitHub documentation directly within M365 apps.

items.name: Obsidian Obsilo Agent Plugin
items.why: Obsilo Agent插件讓Obsidian更像一個代理平台，支援工具、記憶、MCP和任務執行，將筆記本轉化為強大的AI工作區。
items.why_en: The Obsilo Agent plugin transforms Obsidian into an agent platform, supporting tools, memory, MCP, and task execution, turning the notebook into a powerful AI workspace.

items.name: Microsoft Foundry Hosted Agents GA
items.why: Microsoft Foundry的託管代理服務正式發佈，提供生產級代理的受管運行時，支援多框架和端到端追蹤與評估。
items.why_en: Microsoft Foundry's Hosted Agents service reached GA, providing a managed runtime for production agents with multi-framework support and end-to-end tracing and evaluation.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Planner Agent (GA)
items.why: Microsoft 365 Copilot中的Planner代理正式發佈，允許用戶直接在Copilot內創建、更新和管理個人任務與共享計劃。
items.why_en: The Planner agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot reached GA, allowing users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared plans directly within Copilot.
